result.topic_en: Plane coordinate geometry: points given in polar form about (a,b), a relation between the distance and direction from point 1 to point 3, and a derivation showing that a certain point lies on the line through point 3 perpendicular to the line 03.
result.transcription:
Math 28 \quad (28) \quad [-154/113-]
Punkte
0. \quad $a$
1 \quad $a + r\cos l$, \quad $b + r\sin l$
2 \quad $a + r'\cos l'$, \quad $b + r'\sin l'$
3 \quad $a + \varrho\cos\lambda$ \quad $b + \varrho\sin\lambda$
Entfernung von 1 nach 3 ..... $p$, Richtung $l + M$
$\varrho\cos\lambda - r\cos l = p\cos(\lambda + M)$
$\varrho\sin\lambda - r\sin l = p\sin(\lambda + M)$
Hieraus
$\varrho\sin$ [-M-] $M = r\sin(\lambda + M - l)$
Man setze nun
$l - M \pm 90^\circ = N$ und $\pm\frac{r}{\sin M} = n$

methods.what: Elimination of p giving a sine-rule relation
Substitution of an auxiliary angle N and length n, with the sign chosen by the sign of sin M
Resulting polar equation of the locus
Geometric interpretation: the point (a+n cos N, b+n sin N) lies on the line through 3 perpendicular to 03
